parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the interactive messaging application.

parameters.name: BroadCastType
parameters.description:
The mode in which system messages are broadcasted. Valid values:

*   0: specifies that system messages are not broadcasted. This is the default value.
*   1: specifies that system messages are broadcasted to specified users.
*   2: specifies that system messages are broadcasted to the message group.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the message group.

parameters.name: OperatorUserId
parameters.description: The ID of the user who performs the operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live cancel-mute-group-user --app-id VKL3000 --group-id AE35-0000-T95F --cancel-mute-user-list qu000,yu1000 --operator-user-id de100a0 --broad-cast-type 2 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live CancelMuteGroupUser --region cn-hangzhou --AppId VKL3000 --BroadCastType 2 --CancelMuteUserList 'qu000,yu1000' --OperatorUserId de100a0 --GroupId 'AE35-0000-T95F'
